key_insights.franchise_advisory_strength: Perth has a strong, well-established franchise advisory ecosystem with 8+ boutique independent advisors. FranchisingWA, Integral Business Consultants, and Franchise Australia lead with CFE credentials, verified locations, and explicit scaling expertise.
key_insights.law_firm_advisory_gap: Law firm-specific succession planning advisory is underrepresented in Perth. Succession Solutions Perth and Quest Legal are the only law firms explicitly specializing in professional partnership succession. Most law firms offer succession as secondary to general commercial law.
key_insights.general_advisory_maturity: 11 additional boutique firms operate in general business advisory, M&A, and management consulting. These firms are established (many 20-40+ years), director-led, and offer complementary services to the franchise and law firm advisory verticals.
key_insights.geographic_clustering: West Perth dominates (5 firms), followed by Perth CBD (2 firms). Other established suburbs include Mosman Park, Subiaco, Mt Pleasant - suggesting affluent professional hub distribution.
key_insights.boutique_market_positioning: 18 of 18 shortlisted firms explicitly claim boutique/independent status. Leadership naming is standard (17 of 18 have named principals), and the average firm tenure suggests market maturity.

net_new_findings: Analysis focused on law firm and franchise advisory sectors per research brief. Excluded from prior research (energy, tech, construction, property). All 18 firms are net-new discoveries in Perth boutique advisory market for these verticals.
